operations.content: Kids Learn project at /Users/dmitrypotekhin/projects/kids-learn/. Web app for kids' math & Python education. FastAPI backend (port 8000) + React/Vite frontend (port 5173). SQLite. DeepSeek API via OpenAI SDK. Start: ./start.sh. Venv at project root. No auth (single-user MVP). 2 courses: Python Basics (7 tasks) + Math Basics (8 tasks). Task types: choice, number, text, code (sandbox via subprocess).
Projects go in ~/projects/. Standard layout: venv at project root, backend/ (FastAPI, port 8000), frontend/ (Vite+React, port 5173). Node 20 via nvm (default system node is v14). .env for API keys.
User prefers subagent-driven-development (SDD) for executing multi-task implementation plans. Prefers Russian language. DeepSeek API key goes in .env file (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY), not env variable.
